instruction: Set Arial as the default font for the whole document and save your changes.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text font to Arial. The evaluator checks if all paragraphs and runs in the document use Arial font. Custom getter reads the DOCX file and extracts font information from all text runs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the main requirement: all text font changed to Arial
Getter logic properly extracts font names from all paragraphs and table cells
Metric correctly compares all extracted fonts against expected 'Arial' value
Parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses expected.get('font_name') which matches the rules dict structure
Postconfig sleep allows file save to complete before verification
Empty case handling is robust (returns empty list, metric returns 0.0)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter could be more comprehensive by also checking fonts in headers, footers, text boxes, shapes, and footnotes/endnotes to ensure complete coverage
Consider adding explicit file existence check in getter to distinguish between 'file not saved' vs 'file has no text'
